query:
-- First shift existing mesenteric and renal sections up by 4 to make room
UPDATE navigatorOverrides SET sortOrder = sortOrder + 4 WHERE module = 'abdominal_vascular' AND sortOrder >= 5;

-- Insert TIPS section 1: B-mode and Color Doppler Survey (sortOrder 5)
INSERT INTO navigatorOverrides (module, sectionName, probe, items, sortOrder) VALUES (
  'abdominal_vascular',
  'tips:TIPS Stent — B-mode and Color Doppler Survey',
  'Curvilinear 2–5 MHz — right intercostal or subcostal approach',
  '[{"id":"tips_0_0","label":"B-mode: identify TIPS stent within hepatic parenchyma","detail":"The stent appears as two parallel echogenic lines coursing from the right hepatic vein to the right portal vein. Assess stent position and integrity.","critical":true,"sortOrder":0},{"id":"tips_0_1","label":"Color Doppler: confirm intrastent flow (hepatic vein end to portal vein end)","detail":"Confirm continuous color fill throughout the entire stent. A focal color void indicates stenosis (with aliasing) or thrombosis (absent flow). Increase color gain and reduce PRF before concluding thrombosis.","critical":true,"sortOrder":1},{"id":"tips_0_2","label":"Assess for focal color aliasing within stent (stenosis site)","detail":"Aliasing at a focal site within the stent is a reliable sign of stenosis. Note the location (hepatic vein end, mid-stent, or portal vein end) for spectral Doppler sampling.","critical":true,"sortOrder":2},{"id":"tips_0_3","label":"Assess liver parenchyma, ascites, and splenomegaly","detail":"Document residual or new ascites, splenomegaly (splenic length >13 cm), and any focal hepatic lesions. Reduction in ascites and spleen size over time supports adequate TIPS decompression.","critical":false,"sortOrder":3}]',
  5
);

-- Insert TIPS section 2: Spectral Doppler Three-Point Sampling (sortOrder 6)
INSERT INTO navigatorOverrides (module, sectionName, probe, items, sortOrder) VALUES (
  'abdominal_vascular',
  'tips:TIPS Stent — Spectral Doppler (Three-Point Sampling)',
  'Curvilinear 2–5 MHz — right intercostal approach; Doppler angle ≤60°',
  '[{"id":"tips_1_0","label":"Spectral Doppler: PSV at hepatic vein end of stent","detail":"Sample at the most superior aspect of the stent where it enters the hepatic vein. Normal TIPS PSV range: 90–190 cm/s. The hepatic vein end is the most common stenosis site for covered stents.","critical":true,"sortOrder":0},{"id":"tips_1_1","label":"Spectral Doppler: PSV at mid-stent (parenchymal tract)","detail":"Sample at the mid-point of the stent within the hepatic parenchyma. A PSV >220 cm/s at mid-stent suggests focal stenosis. A PSV <50 cm/s suggests shunt dysfunction.","critical":true,"sortOrder":1},{"id":"tips_1_2","label":"Spectral Doppler: PSV at portal vein end of stent","detail":"Sample at the inferior aspect of the stent where it enters the right portal vein. Confirm antegrade flow from portal vein into the stent.","critical":true,"sortOrder":2},{"id":"tips_1_3","label":"Compare all three velocities to patient baseline study","detail":"A decrease of >50 cm/s from the patient own post-procedure baseline, or a focal velocity step-up of >2x between adjacent sampling sites, indicates significant stenosis.","critical":true,"sortOrder":3},{"id":"tips_1_4","label":"Document waveform character at all three sites","detail":"Normal: continuous forward flow throughout. Absent or reversed flow at any site suggests thrombosis. Turbulent, high-velocity waveform at a focal site confirms stenosis.","critical":false,"sortOrder":4}]',
  6
);

-- Insert TIPS section 3: Main Portal Vein Post-TIPS Assessment (sortOrder 7)
INSERT INTO navigatorOverrides (module, sectionName, probe, items, sortOrder) VALUES (
  'abdominal_vascular',
  'tips:Main Portal Vein — Post-TIPS Assessment',
  'Curvilinear 2–5 MHz — oblique subcostal approach along portal vein long axis',
  '[{"id":"tips_2_0","label":"Color Doppler: main portal vein patency and flow direction","detail":"Confirm portal vein patency. Post-TIPS, flow may be hepatopetal or hepatofugal — both are normal. Absent flow suggests portal vein thrombosis.","critical":true,"sortOrder":0},{"id":"tips_2_1","label":"Spectral Doppler: main portal vein PSV","detail":"Normal post-TIPS: PSV ≥30 cm/s indicates adequate decompression. PSV <20 cm/s is a reliable indicator of shunt dysfunction. Compare to post-procedure baseline.","critical":true,"sortOrder":1},{"id":"tips_2_2","label":"Main portal vein diameter","detail":"Portal vein diameter should decrease post-TIPS if adequately decompressed (normal <13 mm). Persistent dilation suggests inadequate decompression or shunt dysfunction.","critical":false,"sortOrder":2}]',
  7
);

-- Insert TIPS section 4: Hepatic Veins Post-TIPS Assessment (sortOrder 8)
INSERT INTO navigatorOverrides (module, sectionName, probe, items, sortOrder) VALUES (
  'abdominal_vascular',
  'tips:Hepatic Veins — Post-TIPS Assessment',
  'Curvilinear 2–5 MHz — right intercostal approach, angled toward IVC',
  '[{"id":"tips_3_0","label":"Hepatic vein receiving TIPS outflow: confirm continuous forward flow","detail":"Post-TIPS, the hepatic vein receiving the stent outflow shows continuous high-velocity turbulent flow (not the normal triphasic waveform). This is expected and should not be misinterpreted as pathology.","critical":true,"sortOrder":0},{"id":"tips_3_1","label":"Assess for hepatic vein stenosis at stent-vein junction","detail":"Focal velocity elevation or color aliasing at the hepatic vein–stent junction suggests stenosis at this site. This is a common cause of late TIPS dysfunction for covered stents.","critical":true,"sortOrder":1},{"id":"tips_3_2","label":"Non-TIPS hepatic veins: confirm normal triphasic waveform","detail":"The hepatic veins not receiving the TIPS outflow should retain their normal triphasic waveform. Loss of triphasic pattern in non-TIPS veins may indicate right heart pathology.","critical":false,"sortOrder":2},{"id":"tips_3_3","label":"IVC patency at hepatic vein confluence","detail":"Assess IVC patency at the hepatic vein–IVC junction. IVC obstruction can cause secondary TIPS dysfunction by increasing outflow resistance.","critical":false,"sortOrder":3}]',
  8
);
